name: Joshua Wise
biography: is an Electrical & Computer Engineering undergraduate at Carnegie Mellon University, and has recently been accepted into the master's program. His area of expertise for a long time has been embedded systems, dating back to the days of the iPAQ h3700, when he ported the Linux USB client stack to the open-source bootloader replacement; more recently, he has held internships at Google, Inc., Cavium Networks, and Tilera, and has served as a teaching assistant for Carnegie Mellon's Operating System Design and Implementation (15-410) class for four semesters.
